payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative DP with 4 states over positions, representing longest subsequence of pattern 1*2*1*2*, which is optimal after one reversal.
payload.rationale: Solution computes maximum LNDS after one reversal by exploiting the property that the sequence consists of only 1s and 2s, so the optimal subsequence can be decomposed into four segments (1s, 2s, 1s, 2s). DP tracks maximum length for each segment.
